crossRefs.note: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,
Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down…
Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of…
Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

translations.web: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
translations.bsb: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
translations.kjv: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
translations.asv: And when he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
